newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's Chirac undecided on early poll -Le Monde.
newsitem.headline: France's Chirac undecided on early poll -Le Monde.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac has still not decided whether to dissolve parliament and hold early general elections in early June, the authoritative daily Le Monde said in an unsourced report on Friday.

Chirac, said to be under pressure from Prime Minister Alain Juppe and other key government leaders to bring forward elections from March, will make his decision over the weekend and announce it next week, the newspaper said.
